name: move_pages
synopsis: long move_pages(int pid, unsigned long count, void *pages[.count], const int nodes[.count], int status[.count], int flags);
description: move_pages moves individual pages of a specified process to another NUMA node. The result of the move is reflected in a status array, and flags control the constraints on the pages to be moved.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The ID of the process in which pages are to be moved; 0 for the calling process.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of pages to move, defining the size of the pages, nodes, and status arrays.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: An array of pointers to the pages that should be moved, aligned to page boundaries.

parameters.name: nodes
parameters.description: An array of integers specifying the desired node for each page; can be NULL to get current node status.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: An array that returns the status of each page after the operation.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags specifying the types of pages to move, such as MPOL_MF_MOVE or MPOL_MF_MOVE_ALL.

return_value.success: Returns zero on success, or a positive value indicating the number of nonmigrated pages.
return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error.

errors.description: One of the target nodes is not allowed by the current cpuset.
Parameter array could not be accessed.
Invalid flags specified or attempt to migrate pages of a kernel thread.
One of the target nodes is not online.
